title: Phasers (new finding, not claimed)
problem: The text says 1 charge to one non-Ultimate gem. The code gives +1 to every qualifying gem and ignores each gem's maximum, so charges can go over max. It also only works on your side: an enemy with Phasers neither zeroes its damage nor restores charges.
notes: Community claim: -. Evidence: same sites; the loop never reads the maximum; side check @0x140ed7481. Fix sketch: S: leave the loop after the first +1 (jump to 0x140ed78ea). Enemy side: S, remove the side check (je @0x140ed7497). The max cap needs H. Triage 2026-10-26: S: leave the loop after the first +1 (jump to 0x140ed78ea) and remove the side check (je @0x140ed7497). The per-gem maximum cap needs a hook (follow-up). 2026-10-26: partial byte patch SU-0155 built (one gem, either side). Still needs a hook: the +1 ignores the gem's maximum charges (bc_EventDamage L5966 increments charges with no cap); hook = clamp charges to the gem's max after the +1. | Batch S: cap built as patch SU-0155-cap (clamp charges to charges_max). In-game test: Phasers: hit with charges near max; charges never exceed each gem's maximum (cap part, patch SU-0155-cap). 2026-10-26: both parts built (SU-0155 side/loop + SU-0155-cap).

release_notes.intended: When the creature attacks, it deals 0 damage but restores 1 charge to a non-Ultimate spell gem.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, it added a charge to every eligible gem, could go above a gem's maximum, and only worked for the player's side.
release_notes.fix: Now one gem gets the charge, for either side (SU-0155), and charges never go above the gem's maximum (separate switch SU-0155-cap).
